doc: FBL 0.11, section 4.9 (The tree): where a comment can start is the grammar's terminals' to say, under ATD section 3.6's lexing. On line 1 the URL token is the longest match at its first byte and runs over both //, so neither is a comment; the // after it is a trailing comment of the link. Line 2 is a leading comment of the link below it. A set of the URL replaces the token's bytes only and keeps the trailing comment. Written here for spec 066 (contracts/fixtures.md, A).

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A set of the URL is a replace-value of the URL token; the // inside the new value is part of it, and the trailing comment stays.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
